# Easy Email Verification

Verify individual email addresses or lists and manage asynchronous bulk email verification jobs.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/easy-email-verification/.

## Actions

- **Download Bulk Results** (read-only): Download the processed text or CSV result file for a completed bulk verification job.
- **Get Bulk Job Status** (read-only): Get the status, progress, and verification totals for one asynchronous bulk verification job.
- **List Bulk Jobs** (read-only): List all bulk verification jobs associated with the connected API key, including their current status and verification counts when…
- **Upload Bulk Email File**: Upload a text or CSV file containing one email address per line and start an asynchronous bulk verification job.
- **Verify Emails**: Verify between 1 and 50 email addresses synchronously and return deliverability details for each address.
